_comment: Disk budget of the VPS root disk (docs/disk.md). One row per owner-bounded path set: caps in GiB, class data|cache|build|history, enforced_by names what holds the cap. scripts/disk_budget.py measures every row daily, fails when the caps sum past max_pct of the disk, and files one signal per owner over a cap. Same row fields as the mini's budget (dotfiles docs/disk.md).

rows.enforced_by: RollHook keeps 5 tags per app; cron/docker-prune 04:30 (images unused 48 h, build cache 3 GB)
volumes are data (ClickHouse TTL 30 d, RollHook 5 tags, the databases); never pruned
cron/docker-prune 04:35: images and volumes daily, build cache capped at 3 GB
one checkout per runner and repo; scripts/gh-runner-clean.sh 04:40 drops self-update leftovers
weatherorb's core job wipes a runner's target above CORE_CACHE_LIMIT_GIB; gh-runner-clean.sh drops superseded toolchains
keyed by lockfile contents; slow growth, signal when over
the factory's own step-host trim: slot copies idle 7 days, bun cache capped at 3 GiB
scripts/exp-sweep.sh 04:45: closed Issue's dir removed, else idle 2 days
small, named; a path that grows past this joins its own row
everything else on the disk (/usr, swap, /var/log, apt, /tmp): used minus the rows above; journald capped at 1 GB
